notes: Card: '9' x13 of the top 32, plus '.', '0', ' (', '8' in bibliographies and tables; top example 'Retrieved: 1⟦9⟧ May 2013'. Probes: three stacked 'Retrieved: 19 <Month> 2013' lines 0.66, a single such line 0.15, '03/19/17' 0.25 (0.14 in a longer line), '18 July 1998' 0.34 on '8', '19 Dic 1994' in a table 0.25; '12 March 2014' 0.04, '2009' 0.01, '29 points' 0.07, year-only APA references 0.08, 'nineteen' 0.03. The + pole fires on '0' after '2' in citation years (2|0|05): both poles read the second digit of a number in reference lists. Density 0.7%, so some weak firing on other list punctuation is expected.
